description: Save books the linked reader names into their taste, up to 25 at once: favorites ("I loved Project Hail Mary for its humor"), books they disliked, or a list of books they have read. Loved books become favorites with the reader's reason, disliked ones books to avoid, and loved or read books not yet shelved go on Finished. Never changes a shelf, rating or note they already have; add_to_library does that. Titles not in the catalog come back under unmatched. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

book.description: "Title by Author" resolves best; a workId or siftivo.com slug also works

why.description: The reader's reason in their words, completing "loved it for ...", e.g. "the humor and the friendship"

name: save_my_taste
title: Save my taste
